name: How long does a typical kitchen plumbing upgrade take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical kitchen plumbing upgrade take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen plumbing upgrade depends on its scope. Minor tasks like faucet or garbage disposal installations can often be completed in a few hours. Larger projects, such as rerouting water lines or installing a new sink with extensive pipe modifications, may take several days. We provide an estimated timeline during the planning phase. Unexpected issues, like discovering outdated or corroded pipes, can extend the project timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Upgrade duration varies by scope; minor tasks take hours, larger projects several days. Timelines are estimated during planning, and unexpected issues can cause delays.
